site.name: Southern Acacia-Commiphora bushlands and thickets · bounded automatic

limitations: Only the explicitly listed trial-supported ecoregion, realm and botanical-country intersections are enabled.
The 100 km envelope is an engineering rollout limit, not a habitat boundary or evidence of local occurrence.
Coordinates select deterministic encounter variations, not continuous georeferenced terrain tiles.
Terrain, soil, moisture, vegetation abundance and device performance remain unmeasured.
Country-native candidates are not verified at this point. Tree anatomy and unnamed low-cover forms remain approximations.
The selected encounter remains artistically unreviewed; reference lighting is not inferred local weather or time of day.
Ground cover is an unnamed functional-form transfer. Regional trees are withheld; terrain, rock, soil and hydrology are synthetic, not measured.
